cases.question: Across all vehicles delivered, including those with no claims, which model year and powertrain combination has the highest total warranty cost divided by the number of vehicles delivered in that combination, and what is that figure?
cases.answer: The model year and powertrain combination with the highest total warranty cost divided by the number of vehicles delivered is 2023 BEV, with an average warranty cost of approximately 8289.45 EUR per vehicle.

trace.purpose: Find the model year and powertrain combination with the highest average warranty cost per vehicle delivered
trace.sql:
SELECT v.model_year, v.powertrain, COALESCE(SUM(w.cost_eur), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle
FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims w ON v.vin = w.vin
GROUP BY v.model_year, v.powertrain
ORDER BY avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: Considerando todos los vehículos entregados, incluidos los que no tienen ninguna reclamación, ¿qué combinación de año de modelo y tren motriz tiene el mayor coste total de garantía dividido entre el número de vehículos entregados de esa combinación, y cuál es esa cifra?
cases.answer: La combinación de año de modelo y tren motriz con el mayor coste total de garantía dividido entre el número de vehículos entregados es 2023 con tren motriz BEV, y la cifra es 8289.45 euros por vehículo.

trace.purpose: Encontrar la combinación de año de modelo y tren motriz con el mayor coste total de garantía dividido por el número de vehículos entregados
trace.sql:
SELECT v.model_year, v.powertrain, SUM(COALESCE(w.cost_eur, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle
FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims w ON v.vin = w.vin
GROUP BY v.model_year, v.powertrain
ORDER BY avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many high-voltage battery warranty claims were opened on model year 2023 BEV vehicles?
cases.answer: There were 462 high-voltage battery warranty claims opened on model year 2023 BEV vehicles.

trace.purpose: Count high-voltage battery warranty claims on 2023 model year BEVs.
trace.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS claim_count
FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc
JOIN gishub.fleet.vehicles v ON wc.vin = v.vin
WHERE wc.component = 'battery_hv'
  AND v.powertrain = 'BEV'
  AND v.model_year = 2023;

cases.answer: Se abrieron 462 reclamaciones de garantía de batería de alta tensión en vehículos BEV del año 2023. Esto se obtuvo contando las reclamaciones con componente 'battery_hv' para vehículos BEV del año 2023.

trace.purpose: Contar las reclamaciones de garantía de batería de alta tensión en vehículos BEV del año 2023

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_battery_hv_claims_2023 FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc

cases.question: Which customer segment accounts for the most warranty cost?
cases.answer: The municipal customer segment accounts for the most warranty cost, totaling 1,254,498.41 EUR. This is determined by summing all warranty claim costs grouped by customer segment and identifying the highest value.

trace.purpose: Determine the customer segment with the highest total warranty cost
trace.sql:
SELECT fc.segment, SUM(wc.cost_eur) AS total_warranty_cost
FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc
JOIN gishub.fleet.vehicles v ON wc.vin = v.vin
JOIN gishub.fleet.fleet_customers fc ON v.customer_id = fc.customer_id
GROUP BY fc.segment
ORDER BY total_warranty_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: ¿Qué segmento de cliente acumula más coste de garantía?
cases.answer: El segmento de cliente que acumula más coste de garantía es el segmento municipal, con un coste total acumulado de garantía de 1.254.498,41 euros.

trace.purpose: Determinar el segmento de cliente con mayor coste acumulado de garantía
trace.sql:
SELECT c.segment, SUM(wc.cost_eur) AS total_warranty_cost
FROM gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc
JOIN gishub.fleet.vehicles v ON wc.vin = v.vin
JOIN gishub.fleet.fleet_customers c ON v.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY total_warranty_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: What percentage of fault events resulted in a warranty claim?
cases.answer: 27.92% of fault events resulted in a warranty claim. This is calculated by dividing the number of distinct warranty claims by the number of distinct fault events.

trace.purpose: Calculate what percentage of fault events resulted in a warranty claim by dividing number of distinct warranty claims by number of distinct fault events.
trace.sql:
SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT wc.claim_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT fe.event_id) AS pct_fault_events_with_claim
FROM gishub.fleet.fault_events fe
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc ON fe.event_id = wc.event_id;

cases.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de eventos de fallo derivó en una reclamación de garantía?
cases.answer:
El 27.93% de los eventos de fallo derivó en una reclamación de garantía.  
(Este porcentaje se calcula como 1210 eventos con reclamación de garantía divididos por 4334 eventos de fallo en total, multiplicado por 100).

trace.purpose: Calcular el porcentaje de eventos de fallo que derivaron en una reclamación de garantía
trace.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT fe.event_id) AS total_fault_events,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wc.event_id) AS fault_events_with_warranty_claims
FROM gishub.fleet.fault_events fe
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc ON fe.event_id = wc.event_id;
